Learn moreSign in Comments 41 Top Show featured comments Newest Show recent comments, including potential spam Description Everything You Need to Know About Chile in Three Minutes 🇨🇱 765Likes21,123ViewsMar 202026 Chile is one of the strangest-shaped countries on Earth — and its geography is completely wild. In three minutes, this breaks down Chile: where it sits along the Pacific coast of South America, why it stretches over 2,600 miles north to south, and how one country contains some of the most extreme landscapes on the planet. From the ultra-dry Atacama Desert — the driest desert on Earth — to massive glaciers, volcanoes, and the rugged beauty of Patagonia, Chile feels like multiple worlds stacked into one narrow strip of land. Fast facts, geography that messes with your sense of scale, cultural surprises, and stats that sound fake but are real — this is Chile explained clean, quick, and built for curiosity.
